login.title: Ganba
login.subtitle: Training and nutrition, together.
login.checkEmail: We sent a link and a code to {email}. Tap the link, or type the code here.
login.error: Couldn't send the link. Try again.
login.badCode: That code didn’t work. Check it or request a new one.
login.linkError: That sign-in link didn’t work here. Request a new one and type the code instead.

body.title: About you
body.subtitle: Used to estimate what you burn.

activity.title: How active are you?
activity.subtitle: Rough averages are fine. We correct this from your real data.
activity.stepsHint: Check your watch or phone health app.
activity.otherHint: Gym, cycling, sports – hours per week.

goal.title: Your goal
goal.subtitle: Where you want to go, and how fast.
goal.limit: Max loss for you: {max} kg/week (1 % of body weight).

result.title: Your plan
result.subtitle: A starting point. It adapts after 2–3 weeks of logging.
result.floored: This hits the minimum safe target. Consider a slower rate.
result.adaptiveNote: After 14 days with enough logs, Ganba calculates what you actually burn and suggests a new target each week.

today.floored: Target is at the safe minimum. Consider a slower rate.
today.noMeals: Nothing logged yet. Tap + to log a meal.
today.garminReauth: Garmin needs you to sign in again.

weight.title: Log weight
weight.hint: Best: morning, after the toilet, before food.
weight.photoFailed: Photo upload failed – saved without photo.

body.title: Body
body.eta: At this pace you reach your goal around {date}.
body.noPhotos: No photos yet. Add one when you log your weight.
body.compareHint: Tap two photos to compare them side by side.

activity.title: Activity
activity.hint: Injured or pausing training? Set running to 0 — your target drops automatically.

macros.title: Nutrition targets
macros.overrideHint: Leave empty to let Ganba calculate and adapt it.

account.title: Account
account.deleteExplain: Deletes all your data and photos permanently. Type DELETE to confirm.

apiKey.title: AI food logging
apiKey.explain: Photo and text logging uses your own Anthropic API key. Create one at console.anthropic.com → API keys. Usage is billed to your Anthropic account (roughly 0.3–0.5 kr per log).
apiKey.invalid: That key doesn’t work. Check it and try again.
apiKey.unavailable: Couldn’t verify the key right now. Try again.

foodLog.title: Log food
foodLog.placeholder: Describe it, e.g. “dinner, extra sauce” or “2 eggs and toast with cheese”
foodLog.noKey: AI logging needs your Anthropic API key.

errors.no_key: Add your Anthropic API key in Profile to use AI logging.
errors.invalid_key: Your API key doesn’t work anymore.
errors.unavailable: The AI is busy right now.

checkin.title: Weekly check-in
checkin.basedOn: Based on {days} logged days and your weight trend.

insufficient.too_early: Keep logging — your first adaptive update comes after about two weeks.
insufficient.few_food_days: Not enough food logged in the last 3 weeks to update your target.
insufficient.few_food_days_last_week: Log food at least 5 days a week to get an update.
insufficient.few_weigh_ins: Weigh in a few more times to get an update.

workout.pushFailed: Couldn’t send to watch — will retry

training.title: Training
training.garminRequired: Connect Garmin to get a training plan
training.garminRequiredHint: Plans use your recent runs for paces and send sessions to your watch.
training.noPlanHint: Pick a race or just build fitness. Ganba plans around the days you can run and sends sessions to your watch.
training.adjustPlaceholder: E.g. “My knee is sore, keep this week easy” or “I’m away 12–18 Oct”
training.endConfirm: End this plan? Sessions are removed from your watch.

errors.no_key: Add your Anthropic key in Profile first.
errors.unavailable: AI is unavailable right now. Try again.
errors.invalid_output: The AI answer didn’t work out. Try rephrasing.

planWizard.title: New plan
planWizard.buildHint: No race — steady progress with easier weeks
planWizard.targetTimeHint: h:mm:ss or mm:ss — empty uses your predicted time
planWizard.recentHint: A recent race or a time you trust — overrides the estimate below
planWizard.sparse: Few recent runs — the plan starts gently.

errors.invalid_race_date: Pick a race date within the next year.
errors.generic: Couldn’t create the plan. Try again.

planWizard.experienced: You’ve trained consistently the last 4 weeks, so the plan starts in the build phase.
planWizard.didQuality: Recent fast laps found — sessions start a level up.

source.run: Based on your {km} km run on {date}
source.laps: Based on your interval laps on {date}
source.garmin: Based on Garmin’s 10K estimate ({time}), read slightly cautiously
source.default: No recent runs found — starting cautiously
source.manual: Based on the time you entered

garmin.title: Garmin
garmin.explain: Ganba reads steps and workouts from Garmin Connect and sends planned sessions to your watch. Your password is used once to sign in and is never stored.
garmin.mfa: Enter the code Garmin sent you
garmin.activityHint: Steps and workouts come from Garmin, so manual activity settings are not used.

errors.mfa_invalid: That code didn’t work. Start again.
errors.mfa_expired: The code step timed out. Start again.
errors.rate_limited: Garmin is limiting sign-ins. Wait a few minutes.
errors.unsupported_session: Signed in, but the session could not be saved. Try again later.

fuel.afterBoth: {p} g protein + {c} g carbs within 2 h
